errors.evidence: The segments are not arranged in descending order of size around the pie chart. The order appears to be LOCAL (94.5%), LLM (3.9%), and then EDGE_P2P (1.6%).
The description fails to mention that the two smaller slices, LLM and EDGE_P2P, are exploded from the main pie chart. This is a significant visual feature used for emphasis.

errors.text_span: the chart visually emphasizes the overwhelming prevalence of local token resolution compared to the hybrid P2P and LLM-based approaches.
errors.evidence: This sentence contains multiple errors. 1) It misinterprets the visual emphasis; the chart visually emphasizes the smaller LLM and EDGE_P2P slices by exploding them, not the large LOCAL slice. 2) It uses the term 'hybrid,' which is not in the figure. 3) It offers an interpretation ('overwhelming prevalence') rather than describing the visual elements.
